summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan addressing all user requirements:
1. Universal text customization across all VST pages via an 'Edit Text' toggle bar + Alt-click mode with Faceplate styling inspector.
2. Direct control selection across Main, LFO, Node, and Macro pages opening the Control Creator drawer.
3. Fix Control Creator knob previewer SVG arc and knurling math to render true skeuomorphic dials.
4. Restore dedicated Sync Time dropdown bar across the top of the Delay section.
5. Relocate Ducking and Delay Asym knobs to the far-right Output & Master section.
6. Fix LFO visualizer to render pure mathematical curves within bounds without wavefolding or radar blip distortion.
7. Verify all features against the uploaded implementation plan.
